title: How to Change Your "Open to Work" Setting on LinkedIn So It's Open to Recruiters Only
description:
You can change your "open to work" setting to show so that it's open to recruiters only. That way, you don't get the green banner around your profile photo on LinkedIn, but you still show up in LinkedIn Recruiter as a filter that people can search by. Here's how to change that setting right in your LinkedIn profile. 

1. You're going to go over to your profile and click the "Open To" button. They recently updated this. It used to be in your settings. 
2. Now you're gonna go over to "Finding a New Job." You can change any of these settings. There's a cool thing where you can add titles you want to be available for.
3. Show that you're open to recruiters only, which will keep LinkedIn from showing the green banner.
